No, friend, I will not stop you.
I would not see you lost, so hear what I know. I have kept this gate through many floods and I have watched the reed roots at low water. Go slowly and watch where you put each foot.
My duty ends at the gate. I will send none of the levy after you. I will be glad to see you come back.
